activity.notes: ATLAS records Clemenceau's second and historically defining term as President of the Council, from November 1917 to January 1920, normalized under the generic Prime Minister role.

sources.title: Georges, Eugène, Benjamin Clemenceau — Assemblée nationale
sources.citation_text: The French National Assembly records Clemenceau as President of the Council and Minister of War from 16 November 1917 to 18 January 1920.
